message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will create a long weekend if you take the adjacent weekend days off). The list includes federal statutory holidays that apply nationwide; some provinces have additional holidays that may also create long weekends.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Potential |
|---------|-------------|-------------|------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sun | Already a weekend |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 | Mon | Long weekend (Feb 18‑21) |
| Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | Feb 20 | Mon | Long weekend (Feb 18‑21) |
| St. Patrick’s Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | Mar 17 | Tue | Long weekend (Mar 15‑18) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | Long weekend (Apr 7‑10) |
| Easter Monday (Ontario, Quebec) | Apr 10 | Mon | Long weekend (Apr 7‑10) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | Long weekend (May 20‑23) |
| National Indigenous Peoples Day (Yukon, Northwest Territories) | Jun 21 | Mon | Long weekend (Jun 19‑22) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Sat | Already a weekend |
| Civic Holiday (most provinces) | Aug 7 | Mon | Long weekend (Aug 5‑8) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | Long weekend (Sep 2‑5) |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 | Mon | Long weekend (Oct 7‑10) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Wed | Long weekend (Nov 10‑13) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | Long weekend (Dec 23‑26) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tue | Long weekend (Dec 23‑26) |

**Notes**

* **Family Day** is observed in Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Ontario on the third Monday in February.  
* **Louis Riel Day** is observed in Manitoba on the same day as Family Day.  
* **St. Patrick’s Day** is a statutory holiday in Newfoundland & Labrador on March 17.  
* **Good Friday** and **Easter Monday** are observed in Ontario and Quebec.  
* **National Indigenous Peoples Day** is observed in Yukon and the Northwest Territories on June 21.  
* **Civic Holiday** is observed in most provinces on the first Monday in August (not a statutory holiday in all provinces).  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like province‑specific details or a calendar view!
